The repaired candidate candidate_2b2ff9e30fd048a0b8640b4d9df3194a passed the independent linear_function check: all four f(x)=k*x+b cases matched expected values (8, -1, 1.0, 4), reset restored k=1,b=0,x=2, the plot visibly changed across 4 distinct images, and there were no page errors or blocked requests. The earlier build error (missingSlope is not defined) was read and fixed. Submitting this checked candidate to the application; publication remains the application's decision.
